stories.title: Grant Forrest Wins Open de España — Earns 2027 Masters and Open Championship Invitations

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
GRANT FORREST WINS THE OPEN DE ESPAÑA.

Birdie on 18 to beat Chacarra and Perez by one shot at 14-under.

Third DP World Tour title. First win outside Scotland.

And the prize: invitations to the 2027 Masters AND The Open at St Andrews.

#SpanishOpen #DPWorldTour

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Grant Forrest wins in Spain and earns:

⛳ 2027 Masters invitation
🏆 2027 Open Championship at St Andrews invitation

A birdie at the last. One shot better than a Spanish hometown favourite.

That's a career round. #SpanishOpen

stories.title: Jon Rahm Leaving LIV Golf — Separation Agreement Deadline October 15

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Jon Rahm is leaving LIV Golf.

His attorney told bankruptcy court the proposed LIV 2.0 terms are "unacceptable." A separation deal is due by October 15.

He's owed between $100M and $150M.

His path back to the PGA Tour? Unclear.

#JonRahm #LIVGolf

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Jon Rahm signed with LIV in December 2023.

Now the bankrupt league can't pay him what it owes.

He wants out. The PGA Tour has no current path for his return.

Two-time major champion. No tour. One of golf's most extraordinary situations.

#JonRahm #LIVGolf
